name: code-on-the-fly
description: Checks files on save and asks a local Gemma model (Ollama) to explain errors.

commands.title: Code On The Fly: Show Panel
Code On The Fly: Restart Server
Code On The Fly: Choose AI Provider
Code On The Fly: Set API Key

enumDescriptions: To the point: the broken line and the AI's fixed line
codeOnTheFly.viewMode.description: What the Code On The Fly panel shows when a file has an error.

codeOnTheFly.fontSize.description: Font size (px) of the text and code in the Code On The Fly panel.

codeOnTheFly.watchFolder.description: Folder (relative to the workspace) whose files are checked on save.

codeOnTheFly.enableAi.description: Ask the local AI model to explain errors.

enumDescriptions: Local Ollama model (default); your code never leaves your machine.
OpenAI API; needs an API key. Your code is sent to OpenAI.
Any other OpenAI-compatible API (OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, LM Studio, …); set the base URL, key, and model.
codeOnTheFly.provider.description: Which AI explains errors. Easiest to change with ⚙ → AI provider, which asks for everything needed.

codeOnTheFly.model.description: Ollama model used when the provider is ollama (see `ollama list`).

codeOnTheFly.openaiModel.description: OpenAI model used when the provider is openai.

codeOnTheFly.customBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API used when the provider is custom (e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1).

codeOnTheFly.customModel.description: Model name used when the provider is custom.

codeOnTheFly.pythonPath.description: Python used to run the Code On The Fly server. Leave empty to use the workspace .venv, then python3 on PATH.

codeOnTheFly.serverScript.description: Path to server.py, relative to the workspace (or absolute).
